description: Report how reliable the index is: freshness (current, stale, partial, unknown), the latest run, project counts by state, and the number of open review candidates.
name: get_index_status

description: Explain how to write a project's Vyasa profile: the file path and format, every field with its limits and allowed values, a complete example, and rules for the writer. Call this before writing `.vyasa/project-profile.toml` in a repository, then write the file yourself; Vyasa only reads it, on its next scan.
name: get_profile_guide

description: Get one project by its opaque `project_id` (from search_projects): identity and aliases, checkouts with their remote, open review candidates, and timestamps. A missing remote is reported as provider `none`.
name: get_project

description: Search the indexed projects. `query` matches a project's name or remote identity (1 to 200 characters, case-insensitive). `state` is one or more of active, missing, inaccessible. `provider` is one or more of github, bitbucket, gitlab, other, local, none. `identity_status` is one or more of resolved, provisional, ambiguous. Filters combine with AND; several values in one filter combine with OR. Results are ordered by name; `limit` is 1 to 100 (default 20); pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next page.
name: search_projects
